headlines.title: Households braced for soaring energy bills with new price cap to be announced
headlines.summary: Domestic gas prices will rise significantly in January under regulator Ofgem's new price cap.

headlines.title: Why French pharma firm Sanofi is paying $41 billion for US company Insmed
headlines.summary: French drugmaker Sanofi has agreed a $41 billion (€37.4bn) all-cash takeover of Insmed, a US biopharma company. The deal, one of its biggest ever, is meant to refill its pipeline of new medicines before its best-selling drug loses patent protection.

headlines.summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

headlines.title: How Trump and Silicon Valley got Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang
headlines.summary: Nvidia's board said Jensen Huang would not return. Six days later, the chipmaker announced his reinstatement after Donald Trump pressed for his return and Elon Musk backed the campaign. Here's how the reversal unfolded and what was at stake for the AI industry.

headlines.title: Nvidia reinstates former CEO Jensen Huang despite China espionage scandal
headlines.summary: Nvidia s board voted unanimously to bring back the disgraced CEO, who resigned this month amid news of his affairs. He s suspected of having had a relationship with a Chinese intelligence asset.

headlines.summary: A year after the Washington summit that brought peace between Armenia and Azerbaijan, the Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (TRIPP) project has entered its construction phase amid broader geopolitical reshaping in the region and beyond.

headlines.title: I ve lost her forever — Why German voice actors are refusing to sign Netflix s AI contract
headlines.summary: For decades, Germans have known Hollywood s biggest stars through the same familiar voices. Now an AI clause in Netflix contracts is splitting the industry over whether it protects performers or exposes them.

headlines.summary: This project was announced on Monday by Emmanuel Macron during a closed-door meeting with industrialists at the Élysée. These mineral stocks will be accompanied by a mechanism of joint purchases .

headlines.title: Germany s Early Start Pension: Can child investment accounts help?
headlines.summary: Germany plans to pay €10 a month into investment accounts for children to encourage long-term retirement saving. Economists say the measure may help build wealth but won t solve the country s pension funding challenge.

headlines.title: How Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia made the world trillions richer
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO made him about $34 billion (€31bn) richer and added roughly $950 billion (€871bn) to the chipmaker's value in a single day. US President Donald Trump, Nvidia's staff and stock markets from New York to Seoul gained too, while Europe got a smaller lift.

trend_headline: 미국 빅테크 변동성과 독일 임단협 파업 교차
summary: 엔비디아 젠슨 황의 복귀와 미국발 대외 관세 우려가 글로벌 증시를 흔드는 가운데, 독일에서는 IG Metall 주도로 메르세데스벤츠와 BMW 등 핵심 제조업 공장이 24시간 파업에 돌입하며 공급망과 경기 둔화 우려를 키우고 있습니다. 프랑스는 가스·원자재 안보 강화를 위해 희토류 전략 비축에 나섰으며, 영국 등 유럽 전역은 치솟는 에너지 요금 압박에 직면해 있습니다.
key_points: 미국 트럼프 행정부의 개입으로 엔비디아 CEO 젠슨 황이 복귀하며 유럽 반도체(ASML, 노키아 등) 주가가 일시 반등했으나 변동성이 확대됨
독일 노조 IG Metall의 파업으로 메르세데스벤츠, BMW 등 주요 자동차 및 산업재 생산 차질 발생
프랑스 정부, 에마뉘엘 마크롱 주도하에 핵심 광물 및 희토류 전략 비축 프로젝트 가동
